== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rebel Reinforcements (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_160</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 161), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-161-Rebel_Reinforcements.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-rebelreinforcements-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Rebel Reinforcements (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Once per game, if opponent has more cards with ability on table than you do, draw destiny and retrieve up to that number of Rebel characters and/or Rebel starships (may take one retrieved card into hand).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L5834</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_106</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number 161, Virtual Block 1 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
